title: GPU-Accelerated Robust MA--RIS Pre-Optimization for Communication and Target Illumination
abstract: arXiv:2610.22431v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Movable antennas (MAs) and reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RISs) offer strong spatial control for integrated sensing and communication (ISAC), but repeatedly adapting MA positions and RIS phases to each channel realization can be impractical. This letter develops a GPU-accelerated robust pre-optimization framework that jointly selects slow-timescale MA geometry and RIS phases and returns a reusable Pareto set balancing expected worst-user rate and transmit-side worst-target illumination. The illumination objective measures directional transmitted power rather than complete echo-detection or parameter-estimation performance. The proposed Regime-Aware Multiobjective Pre-optimization (RAMP) preserves regime-specific Pareto populations, regulates cross-regime mating using Pareto-survival feedback, and constructs a worst-regime robust archive. Numerical results demonstrate competitive robust Pareto quality against the considered evolut

translated_title: 面向通信与目标照射的GPU加速鲁棒MA-RIS预优化
translated_abstract: 可移动天线（MA）与可重构智能表面（RIS）为通感一体化（ISAC）提供了强大的空间控制能力，但针对每次信道实现反复调整MA位置和RIS相位可能并不现实。本文提出了一种GPU加速的鲁棒预优化框架，联合选择慢时间尺度的MA几何构型与RIS相位，并输出一个可复用的帕累托解集，以平衡期望的最差用户速率与发射侧的最差目标照射。其中，照射目标衡量的是方向性发射功率，而非完整的回波检测或参数估计性能。所提出的“体制感知多目标预优化”方法（RAMP）保留了各体制特有的帕累托种群，利用帕累托存活反馈调节跨体制交配，并构建了最差体制鲁棒档案。数值结果表明，与所考虑的进化算法基准相比，该方法展现出具有竞争力的鲁棒帕累托解质量。（原文摘要末尾截断）
tldr: 提出GPU加速的鲁棒预优化框架RAMP，通过联合优化慢时间尺度的可移动天线构型与RIS相位，生成兼顾最差用户速率与最差目标照射的可复用帕累托解集，免去对每个信道实现反复优化的需要。
en_tdlr: Proposes RAMP, a GPU-accelerated robust pre-optimization framework that jointly optimizes slow-timescale movable antenna geometry and RIS phases, yielding a reusable Pareto set balancing worst-user rate and worst-target illumination without per-realization re-optimization.
